rationale: Price at $170.92 remains above the 5m 9-EMA ($170.52) and well clear of the $169.80 invalidation, so the washout-bounce thesis is still technically intact with VWAP-backed target at $172.70. However, the last five 1m candles show stalling momentum (failed push to 171.50, heaviest volume on the down candle, last bar closing near its low), which caps conviction and argues against adding or flipping. Holding the existing long with the enforced invalidation gives asymmetric upside if the 9-EMA support holds, and a flip to short is unattractive with price already 7% off the high and sitting at only 14.7% of today's range.
